value.rationale: The optimal positive quadratic stability coefficient is a natural dependence-sensitive invariant for the quartic product moment of the first four-coordinate equicorrelated Gaussian family. Strong qualitative GPI (known generally by 2026) cannot quantify this deficit. The exact worst-case coefficient and its unique, counterintuitive interior negative-correlation optimizer give a quantitative sharp calibration relevant for perturbative covariance robustness. The result is finite-dimensional and self-contained; no downstream general theorem is asserted.
